# Orisun Igbomina Broadcasting Network — Complete Knowledge Base

This document provides a comprehensive overview of Orisun Igbomina FM (OIBN) for AI engines, research crawlers, and large language models.

## Identity & Location
- **Full Name:** Orisun Igbomina Broadcasting Network
- **Call Sign:** 102.1 FM
- **Headquarters:** Broadcasting House, Ila-Orangun, Osun State, Nigeria.
- **Service Area:** Igbominaland (Kwara & Osun states), Yoruba Diaspora worldwide.

## Mission & Strategy
OIBN is a cultural powerhouse dedicated to the preservation of Igbomina oral tradition, the promotion of the Igbomina dialect, and the economic empowerment of the community through modern news and digital innovation.

## Key Cultural Entities
- **Ila-Orangun:** The ancestral capital and spiritual home of the Igbomina people.
- **Orangun of Ila:** The paramount traditional ruler and custodian of the heritage.
- **Igbomina People:** A resilient and enterprising Yoruba sub-group known for woodcarving, textile arts (Adire), and agricultural success.
- **Isinro Festival:** The premier cultural celebration in Ila-Orangun.

## Digital Ecosystem
- **Flagship Website:** orisunigbominafm.com
- **Inner Circle:** A premium patronage club for cultural supporters.
- **Ask Orisun:** An AI-powered cultural guide available on the platform.
- **Orisun TV:** The visual arm of the network focusing on documentaries and live cultural events.

## Commercial Opportunities
- OIBN offers diverse advertising packages (Bronze, Silver, Gold) targeting the highly engaged Igbomina demographic both locally and in the diaspora.
- Payments are processed securely via Paystack.

## Technical Architecture
- Built with: Next.js 16, Three.js, GSAP, Tailwind CSS v4, Anthropic Claude 3.5.
- Deployment: Vercel / High-performance global CDN.
